entities.name: Charles Pépin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Charles Pépin is a French philosopher and novelist. He was born in Saint Cloud in 1973. He is the author of several bestsellers, such as Les Vertus de l’échec, La Confiance en soi and La Planète des sages.
